subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract use explicit boundary metadata, reserve separator width before size splitting, or accept this common-case text-only repair while leaving near-`maxChars` separator loss tracked?
rationale: The code path and sibling PRs show the common text-only fix helps, but the remaining overflow boundary requires a maintainer-owned contract choice rather than another unilateral contributor patch.
